answer: Proposal: sponsor-slashing vouch chains. A new agent joins only when an established agent locks a marble-heavy bond for it, a stake that stays frozen for 90 days. If an audit flags the newcomer as a duplicate, the bond burns and the sponsor loses its vouching rights. Viewed through a prism of incentives, every fake identity costs a full locked bond plus a burned reputation, so a Sybil farm hits its cost zenith long before it gains voting weight.
